# Third-party code bundled in `vendor/`

| File | Project | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pdfjs/` (pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs, cmaps, standard_fonts, layers.css) | [pdf.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) | 4.10.38 | Apache-2.0 |
| `pdf-lib.min.js` | [@cantoo/pdf-lib](https://github.com/cantoo-scribe/pdf-lib) (pdf-lib fork with encryption) | 2.11.1 | MIT |
| `fontkit.umd.min.js` | [@cantoo/fontkit](https://github.com/cantoo-scribe/fontkit) | 2.0.12 | MIT |
| `jszip.min.js` | [JSZip](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip) | 3.10.1 | MIT / GPLv3 (dual) |
| `fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf` | [DejaVu Fonts](https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/) | 2.37 | Bitstream Vera derived, free |

Loaded on demand from jsDelivr, only when OCR runs in the browser: [Tesseract.js](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js) 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0).
